description: This is a shell script designed to perform a preflight check to verify that the environment has Java 21 or higher installed. It validates environment variables (`JAVA_TOOLCHAIN_JAVA21_HOME`, `JAVA_21_HOME`, `JAVA_HOME`) as well as the 'java' command in the system's PATH to ensure the Java version is at least 21. The script exits with a non-zero status if any of these checks fail, enabling automated systems to detect incompatible Java environments before proceeding with builds.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: parse_major_version
methods.description: Parses and extracts the major Java version number from the output of 'java -version'. Handles both legacy and modern version string formats.

methods.name: check_env_home
methods.description: Checks if an environment-specific Java home variable is set and points to an executable Java that meets the minimum version requirement.

methods.name: check_path_java
methods.description: Checks the 'java' command in the system's PATH to verify it is Java 21+.
